Major AI-driven exploitation campaign: 395 orgs compromised across 48 countries using AI agents (Codex, DeepSeek) to build and refine exploits for CVE-2026-81578 and CVE-2026-82078.

CVE-2026-81578.evidence: GreyNoise reports 440 PaperCut instances compromised starting Aug 31, with credential harvesting from 280 victims.

CVE-2026-82078.evidence: Same campaign; both flaws flagged as actively exploited by CISA earlier this month.

decisions.reason: Three distinct threat clusters (including state-sponsored) actively exploiting Cisco FMC auth bypass (CVE-2026-20079, CVSS 10.0) and static creds (CVE-2026-20316) to deploy Qilin ransomware and Cyclops Blink.

CVE-2026-20079.evidence: Cisco Talos confirms three clusters using this auth bypass for root code execution on FMC devices, deploying web shells and ransomware.

CVE-2026-20316.evidence: Static credential flaw combined with other FMC vulns for privilege escalation; exploited in the same campaigns.
